S-WIDGET-DEBUGGER.Purpose: Widget Inspector tool: in-game inspector of the live widget tree and its behaviors — property access, behavior adapters, runtime observation via patches, overlays, and a FlexVerse-built inspector UI.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Tool entry: WidgetInspector : Tool, debugger window and tool settings.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Read-only property access abstraction (IAccessor) and behavior-type presentation (IBehaviorAdapter).
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Inspection tree building and debug view-models.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: Runtime observation: generated property refs, WatchRef, weak change tracking, public-method Harmony observation, a game hotkey hook and whole-engine isolation.
Scope.SCP-IN-005: IMGUI overlays (box model, change flash) and the inspector UI built on FlexVerse widgets.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Tool discovery and lifecycle — owned by M-TOOL and M-TOOL-MANAGER (project-level).

Principles.PRIN-001: Debugger objects must never appear in or affect the inspected product tree (M-DBG-TRACK isolation).
Principles.PRIN-002: Inspector UI dogfoods the framework: every debugger widget is a Widget, no separate UI stack.

Requirements.REQ-001: The inspector tree refreshes from the live WidgetEngine tree while open without forcing extra reconciliations (M-DBG-TRACK.REQ-001).
Requirements.REQ-002: Behavior presentation is complete: every Behavior subtype has an IBehaviorAdapter or falls back to DefaultAdapter (M-DBG-ADAPT.REQ-001).
Requirements.REQ-003: FlexVerse observation uses a postfix only; the game hotkey prefix consumes only F12. P-FLEXVERSE engine behavior is unchanged (M-DBG-TRACK.REQ-001, P-FLEXTOOLS.PRIN-003).
